#### Checklist

- [ ] The fast test suite passes (`python -m pytest tests -q`).
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests.
- [ ] Rule or engine changes were also checked with `--oracle=strict`.
- [ ] The documentation is updated, and code shown in it runs.
- [ ] An entry is added under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
